# Investigate

## Goal

Explain an observed problem through reproducible evidence.

## Procedure

Follow [Debugging](../Guidelines/Debugging.md). Record the report, expected result, reproduction, environment, and hypotheses in [Copilot_Investigate.md](../TaskLogs/Copilot_Investigate.md). Test hypotheses using focused inspection and diagnostics. Separate observed facts from inferences and keep sensitive content out of logs.

If the user requested a fix, continue through implementation and regression verification. If the request is investigation-only, produce findings and a concrete proposed fix without expanding the mutation scope.

## Output

Supported findings, ruled-out hypotheses, remaining uncertainty, and the next actionable step.
